request: Measure AI Core parent cgroup physical idle memory current/anon/file/swap PSI and throttling, without model execution; publish bounded values for performance baseline. Do not alter product or Gateway.

bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
p=/sys/fs/cgroup/ai.slice/ai-core.slice
test -f "$p/memory.current"
r=0
for n in ai-granite ai-qwen3 ai-ministral ai-coder; do
 test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$n")" = true && r=$((r+1)) || :
done
mem=$(cat "$p/memory.current")
anon=$(awk '$1=="anon"{print $2}' "$p/memory.stat")
file=$(awk '$1=="file"{print $2}' "$p/memory.stat")
swap=$(cat "$p/memory.swap.current")
psi=$(awk 'NR==1{print $2}' "$p/memory.pressure")
throttle=$(awk '$1=="nr_throttled"{print $2}' "$p/cpu.stat")
msg="AI_CORE_IDLE_CGROUP_RESOURCES RESIDENT=$r MEM_BYTES=$mem ANON_BYTES=$anon FILE_BYTES=$file SWAP_BYTES=$swap MEMORY_PSI=$psi THROTTLED_COUNT=$throttle"
gh api -X POST repos/seigo-gace/ai-core/issues/1/comments -f body="$msg" --jq '.html_url' >/dev/null
echo AI_CORE_IDLE_CGROUP_RESOURCES=RECORDED

chat_decision_checkpoint.source_evidence: AI Core physical 2→3→2 and restart recovery PASS, exact 144 tests PASS. Second-product Astera has adapter but absent persistent credentials and Host probe blocked by Node SyntaxError/Gateway command transport, avoid further expensive model inference. Measure physical idle parent cgroup anon/file/swap/PSI and resident only.
